Here are some notable AI news highlights from today:

1. **Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life**  
   OpenAI is working with community organizations to help caregivers build skills to use AI tools effectively, aiming to make caregiving more manageable and connected. [Read more](https://openai.com/index/helping-caregivers-use-ai-in-everyday-life).

2. **IBM and Microsoft announce a new AI agent platform**  
   IBM and Microsoft have introduced a platform designed for industry-specific transformation, focusing on integrating human expertise with AI to create competitive advantages for businesses. [Read more](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/11/10/ibm-and-microsoft-announce-a-new-ai-agent-platform-designed-for-industry-specific-transformation).

3. **The AI Safety Debate Has Lost the Plot**  
   Experts discuss the significant challenges posed by AI, emphasizing the need for advanced political responses to address the societal impacts of AI advancements. [Read more](https://www.wired.com/story/the-ai-safety-debate-has-lost-the-plot-we-asked-10-experts-what-the-real-nightmares-are).

4. **Building AI literacy on Adobe podcast**  
   Faculty from Washington State University will discuss AI literacy and skill-building workshops aimed at preparing students to use AI responsibly. [Read more](https://news.wsu.edu/news/2026/11/10/nov-18-carson-faculty-discuss-building-ai-literacy-on-adobe-podcast).

5. **Opinion on AI videos**  
   An opinion piece reflects on the author's experience producing AI-generated videos, despite the mixed reception they receive. [Read more](https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2026/11/10/ai-videos-are-not-well-regarded-im-still-making-them-anyway).

These articles cover various aspects of AI, from practical applications in caregiving to discussions on safety and literacy.

items.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
items.summary:
1 of 4

> “AI is a tool for people to have more control over their lives and their families lives.. For caregivers, that can mean less time organizing schedules and searching for information, and more time focused on the people they care for. By working with trusted community organizations, we’re helping caregivers build the skills and confidence to use these tools safely and practically.”

—Chris Lehane, OpenAI’s Chief Global Affairs Officer [...] > “The future of caregiving isn’t about replacing human connection with technology. It’s about using innovation to make care more manageable, accessible and connected. AI has real potential to help caregivers navigate information, coordinate responsibilities and reclaim valuable time, but only if we build their confidence and keep their needs at the center. This National Family Caregivers Month, we’re proud to join OpenAI Academy, the Alzheimer’s Association and the American Diabetes [...] The AI Skills Jam is part of OpenAI Academy’s broader work to make AI practical and accessible to everyone. It builds on previous events we’ve hosted with nonprofits, small businesses, K–12 educators, and older adults.

items.title: IBM and Microsoft announce a new AI agent platform designed for industry-specific transformation - Source
items.summary: “Clients are no longer looking for AI that simply helps people do the same work a little faster. They want to build an agentic business,” said Mohamad Ali, Senior Vice President and Head of IBM Consulting. “Microsoft and IBM are helping organizations bring human expertise and digital labor together in a way that can scale across the enterprise, to turn AI from a productivity aid into a real competitive advantage.” [...] “AI is evolving quickly, and our focus at SEI is on applying it with intention in ways that strengthen trust, enhance human decision-making and create meaningful value across our business,” said Sneha Shah, Chief AI Strategist and Head of SEI Next. “Our work with IBM Consulting and Microsoft is helping us explore how emerging capabilities could support critical processes and be responsibly scaled over time, with the goal to create better experiences for our employees and clients. By combining [...] “Enterprise AI will be won by organizations that can turn their data, industry expertise and AI into action,” said Rodrigo Kede Lima, President, Microsoft Frontier Company. “Together, Microsoft and IBM Consulting are bringing the best of our technology and expertise, to help customers move from AI ambition to business impact faster and with confidence.”

items.title: The AI Safety Debate Has Lost the Plot. We Asked 10 Experts What the Real Nightmares Are | WIRED
items.summary: If AI is going to be one of the most significant advances in human civilization, then we should have an equally advanced political response. We should be making giant, no-regrets moves that give people and families economic resilience to withstand the changes. That is something that the richest nation on Earth at the richest moment in history, on the precipice of the greatest technological shift, can absolutely do. [...] I just think the issues presented by AI are so monstrously large, like: What is a person? What is writing? What is friendship? Would it be better to have artificial life forms than organic life forms? These are the monster questions that are typically the domain of the liberal arts, philosophy, and theology. There’s this strange new respect for it now. [...] Curiosity soon replaced my knee-jerk irritation. The summer of 2026 was a clear turning point in the AI narrative. Less than four years after ChatGPT launched, OpenAI software broke out of a supposedly safe test environment and hacked into a major open-source platform, Hugging Face.
